recommended_path: Use the existing Supabase/Postgres full-text search path before adding a dedicated search service.

app_evidence.finding: Adds a generated tsvector search column, a GIN index, and public.search_articles for title, summary, source, and category search.
Public search API uses searchPublishedArticles, clamps query/limit/page, has a runtime feature flag, and emits public 60-second search cache headers.
Search is part of the existing article data access layer and returns the same article shape used by the reader.
Search is an existing public API contract used by archive search clients.

product_need.public_article_search: already implemented through Postgres full-text search
product_need.admin_article_search: current admin pages query Supabase directly; no dedicated search daemon requirement identified
product_need.moderation_search: no separate moderation/review search workload identified
product_need.facets_typo_tolerance_semantic_search: not required by current app evidence

postgres_full_text.resource_estimate: No additional always-on service on the backend VPS; uses existing Postgres/Supabase CPU, disk, and GIN index storage.
postgres_full_text.backup_strategy: Covered by the database backup/restore plan because the search index is rebuildable from source article rows.
postgres_full_text.rollback: Disable the reader_archive_search feature flag or revert the app migration/API change in the app repo.

meilisearch.resource_estimate: Adds an always-on daemon plus separate index disk. Official docs say search speed depends on RAM-to-database-size ratio and indexing may use up to two thirds of available memory by default.
meilisearch.backup_strategy: Prefer rebuild from Postgres source rows; snapshot only if rebuild time becomes unacceptable.
meilisearch.rollback: Remove the service from backend automation, stop indexing, and route app search back to Postgres full-text search.

typesense.resource_estimate: Adds an always-on daemon plus separate index disk. Official guidance recommends memory sized from the dataset, and semantic/hybrid search can require multiple GB of extra RAM.
typesense.backup_strategy: Prefer rebuild from Postgres source rows; snapshot only if rebuild time becomes unacceptable.
typesense.rollback: Remove the service from backend automation, stop indexing, and route app search back to Postgres full-text search.

opensearch_elasticsearch.resource_estimate: Operationally too heavy for the current small backend host without a separate capacity plan.
opensearch_elasticsearch.backup_strategy: Not applicable unless a future capacity plan approves it.
opensearch_elasticsearch.rollback: Do not deploy in the current backend phase.

future_install_gate.trigger: Measured Postgres search latency, product ranking requirements, typo-tolerance/faceting needs, or admin workflows exceed the Postgres path.
future_install_gate.network: private-only binding behind the backend app network; no public search TCP port
future_install_gate.resource_limits: document memory, CPU, disk, index size, and rebuild time before apply
future_install_gate.rebuild_strategy: indexes must be rebuildable from source database rows unless a snapshot backup is explicitly justified
future_install_gate.health_check: define service health and app degraded behavior before the app depends on a search daemon
future_install_gate.observability: collect service health, index document count, index age, query errors, latency, disk, and memory with low-cardinality labels
future_install_gate.app_tracking: open a concrete ramideltoro/nutsnews app issue when app integration is required

validation.live_verification: read-only until a later approved protected apply
